verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              ततोऽहं समनुज्ञाप्य कालीं गन्धवतीं तदा। मन्त्रिणश्चर्त्विजश्चैव तथैव च पुरोहितान् ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Then did I, submitted the matter before our advisers, priests and spiritual guides,

verses.sanskrit: समनुज्ञासिषं कन्यामम्बां ज्येष्ठां नराधिप। अनुज्ञाता ययौ सा तु कन्या शाल्वपतेः पुरम् ॥२॥
verses.english: Grant that eldest among the girls, Amba to go away, 0 ruler of men; and the girl too, obtaining the permission, went to the capital of the king of the Shalvas.

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धैर्द्विजातिभिर्गुप्ता धात्र्या चानुगता तदा। अतीत्य च तमध्वानमासाद्य नृपतिं तथा ॥३॥
verses.english: She was escorted by old twice born men and followed by maid servants; and after traveling the whole distance she reached the presence of that king.

verses.sanskrit: सा तमासाद्य राजानं शाल्वं वचनमब्रवीत्। आगताऽहं महाबाहो त्वामुद्दिश्य महामते ॥४॥
verses.english: She, going to the king of the “Shalvas, said these words:-"I have come, O you of long arms, expecting to be united with you, O you of great intelligence."

verses.sanskrit: तामब्रवीच्छाल्वपतिः स्मयन्निव विशांपते। त्वयाऽन्यपूर्वया नाहं भार्यार्थी वरवर्णिनि ॥५॥
verses.english: The king of the Shalvas, however said to him with a laughter, O lord of the universe, "O you of good complexion, I do not desire to take you for my wife for you had before been taken by another.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ भद्रे पुनस्तत्र सकाशं भीष्मकस्य वै। नाहमिच्छामि भीष्मेण गृहीतां त्वां प्रसह्य वै ॥६॥
verses.english: Go therefore, gentle lady, again to Bhishma. I dot desire to have you who had been taken away by Bhishma by force.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि भीष्मेण निर्जित्य नीता प्रीतिमती तदा। परामृश्य महायुद्धे निर्जित्य पृथिवीपतीन् ॥७॥
verses.english: At that time were you cheerfully led away by Bhishma who vanquished all the kings.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं त्वय्यन्यपूर्वायां भार्यार्थी वरवर्णिनि। कथमस्मद्विधो राजा परपूर्वां प्रवेशयेत् ॥८॥
verses.english: O you of fair complexion, I do not desire as my wife, yourself who had been accepted by another, for how can a king like us accept a girl

verses.sanskrit: नारीं विदितविज्ञानः परेषां धर्ममादिशन्। यथेष्टं गम्यतां भद्रे मा त्वां कालोऽत्यगादयम् ॥९॥
verses.english: A king, who is familiar with every science and who lays down laws for others. Go wherever you please, gentle lady, and do not waste your time.”

verses.sanskrit: अम्बा तमब्रवीद्राजन्ननङ्गशरपीडिता। नैवं वद महीपाल नैतदेवं कथञ्चन ॥१०॥
verses.english: Amba, being struck with the darts of love, said to that king:-“Do not speak thus, O ruler of the earth, it can not be so by any means.

verses.sanskrit: नास्मि प्रीतिमती नीता भीष्मेणामित्रकर्शन। बलान्नीताऽस्मि रुदती विद्राव्य पृथिवीपतीन् ॥११॥
verses.english: Never was I cheerfully led away by Bhishma, O chastiser of enemies. Weeping, I was led away by force after he had vanquished the lords of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: भजस्व मां शाल्वपते भक्तां बालामनागसम्। भक्तानां हि परित्यागो न धर्मेषु प्रशस्यते ॥१२॥
verses.english: Accept me, O lord of the Shalvas, accept a girl who is innocent. No religion approves of the direction of the devoted.

verses.sanskrit: साऽहमामन्त्र्य गाङ्गेयं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनम्। अनुज्ञाता च तेनैव ततोऽहं भृशमागता ॥१३॥
verses.english: I have come here without any loss of time after taking leave of the son of Ganga, who never turns back from the field of battle and with his permission.

verses.sanskrit: न स भीष्मो महाबाहुर्मामिच्छति विशाम्पते। भ्रातृहेतोः समारंभो भीष्मस्येति श्रुतं मया ॥१४॥
verses.english: That Bhishma of long arms does not want me, O lord of the universe and this exertion of Bhishma is for the sake of his brother, I have heard.

verses.sanskrit: भगिन्यौ मम ये नीते अम्बिकाम्बालिके नृप। प्रादाद्विचित्रवीर्याय गाङ्गेयो हि यवीयसे ॥१५॥
verses.english: Those two sisters of mine, Ambika, and Ambalika, who had been led away, have been made over by the son of Ganga to his younger brother Vichitravirya.

verses.sanskrit: यथा शाल्वपते नान्यं वरं ध्यामि कथञ्चन। त्वामृते पुरुषव्याघ्र तथा मूर्धानमालभे ॥१६॥
verses.english: I do not, O lord of the Shalvas, desire any husband save yourself, O foremost among men, I swear by my heart.

verses.sanskrit: न चान्यपूर्वा राजेन्द्र त्वामहं समुपस्थिता। सत्यं ब्रवीमि शाल्वैतत् सत्येनात्मानमालभे ॥१७॥
verses.english: O chief among kings, I do not come to you as one who has before been ravished by another. I am speaking the truth, O lord of the Shalvas, I swear by my soul and by truth.

verses.sanskrit: भजस्व मां विशालाक्ष स्वयं कन्यामुपस्थिताम्। अनन्यपूर्वां राजेन्द्र त्वत्प्रसादाभिकाङ्क्षिणीम् ॥१८॥
verses.english: Accept me, O you of big eyes, who am a girl and have come of my own will desirous of your favours, and without having been ravished by another, O chief among kings."

verses.sanskrit: तामेवं भाषमाणां तु शाल्वः काशिपतेः सुताम्। अत्यजद्भरतश्रेष्ठ जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Shalva however abandoned that daughter of the ruler of the Kashis who spoke thus, O chief among the Bharatas, like a serpent casting off its slough.

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैर्याच्यमानस्तया नृपः। नाश्रद्दधच्छाल्वपतिः कन्यायां भरतर्षभ ॥२०॥
verses.english: The king of the Shalvas did not look graciously on that girl who spoke in this and several other strains.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा मन्युनाऽऽविष्टा ज्येष्ठा काशिपतेः सुता। अब्रवीत् साश्रुनयना बाष्पविप्लुतया गिरा ॥२१॥
verses.english: Then did that eldest daughter of the ruler of the Kashis struck with grief say with eyes bathed in tears in a voice choked with tears.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया त्यक्ता गमिष्यामि यत्र तत्र विशाम्पते। तत्र मे गतयः सन्तु सन्तः सत्यं यथा ध्रुवम् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Being abandoned by you I shall go wherever I please, O lord of the universe, making the righteous my refuge, for truth is indestructible.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तां भाषमाणां तु कन्यां शाल्वपतिस्तदा। परितत्याज कौरव्य करुणं परिदेवतीम् ॥२३॥
verses.english: At that time the lord of the Shalvas thus abandoned that girl, O Kaurava, who spoke to him plaintively.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ गच्छेति तां शाल्वः पुनः पुनरभाषत। बिभेमि भीष्मात् सुश्रोणि त्वं च भीष्मपरिग्रहः ॥२४॥
verses.english: Shalva said to her again and again “go, go, I fear Bhishma, O you of beautiful hips, for you are Bhishma's capture."
verses.bhavadeepa: करुणं दीनं यथा स्यात्तथा परिदेवतीं शोचन्तीम् ॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु सा तेन शाल्वेनादीर्घदर्शिना। निश्चक्राम पुराद्दीना रुदती कुररी यथा ॥२५॥
verses.english: Being thus spoken to by that Shalva of short foresight, she issued out of that city sorrowing, weeping like a she osprey.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              निष्क्रामन्ती तु नगराच्चिन्तयामास दुःखिता। पृथिव्यां नास्ति युवतिर्विषमस्थतरा मया ॥२६॥
verses.english: Bhishma said As she sorrowfully issued out of the capital she thought within herself: “In this world there is no young woman in a more difficult situation than myself.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धुभिर्विप्रहीणाऽस्मि शाल्वेन च निराकृता। न च शक्यं पुनर्गन्तुं मया वारणसाह्वयम् ॥२७॥
verses.english: I have been robbed of my friends and wronged by Shalva nor am I capable of going back to the city called after the elephant.

verses.sanskrit: अनुज्ञाता तु भीष्मेण शाल्वमुद्दिश्य कारणम्। किं नु गर्हाम्यथात्मानमथ भीष्मं दुरासदम् ॥२८॥
verses.english: The reason being that I was permitted by Bhishma to leave him with the object of going to Shalva. Whom shall I blame, myself or Bhishma who is hard to be approached,

verses.sanskrit: अथवा पितरं मूढं यो मेऽकार्षीत् स्वयंवरम्। मयाऽयं स्वकृतो दोषो याऽहं भीष्मरथात्तदा ॥२९॥
verses.english: Or that foolish father who made arrangements for the selection of a husband by myself. It was a fault of mine own that at that time from Bhishma's chariot,

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्ते दारुणे युद्धे शाल्वार्थं नापतं पुरा। तस्येयं फलनिर्वृत्तिर्यदापन्नाऽस्मि मूढवत् ॥३०॥
verses.english: I did not leap down to join Shalva, when Bhishma was engaged in fierce battle. The result of that is this, namely that I have been made a fool of.

verses.sanskrit: धिग्भीष्मं धिक्च मे मन्दं पितरं मूढचेतसम्। येनाहं वीर्यशुल्केन पण्यस्त्रीव प्रचोदिता ॥३१॥
verses.english: Shame on Bhishma, shame on my idiotic father of foolish heart that fixed velour to be my dower as if I were a woman who could be sold at a price,

verses.sanskrit: धिङ्मां धिक् शाल्वराजानं धिग्धातारमथापि वा। येषां दुर्नीतभावेन प्राप्ताऽस्म्यापद‌मुत्तमाम् ॥३२॥
verses.english: Shame on myself, shame on king Shalva, shame also on the creator through whose fault I am now placed in this difficulty.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वथा भागधेयानि स्वानि प्राप्नोति मानवः। अनयस्यास्य तु मुखं भीष्मः शान्तनवो मम ॥३३॥
verses.english: In all circumstances does a man go through his share of worldly happiness and misery but Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, is the prime cause of this difficulty.

verses.sanskrit: सा भीष्मे प्रतिकर्तव्यमहं पश्यामि साम्प्रतम्। तपसा वा युधा वाऽपि दुःखहेतुः स मे मतः ॥३४॥
verses.english: I now see that for the present I should have revenge on that Bhishma either by austerities or by battle, for in my opinion he is the cause of my misery.

verses.sanskrit: को नु भीष्मं युधा जेतुमुत्सहेत महीपतिः। एवं सा परिनिश्चित्य जगाम नगराद्बहिः ॥३५॥
verses.english: What ruler of the earth would venture to fight with Bhishma." Thinking thus she went out of the city,

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमं पुण्यशीलानां तापसानां महात्मनाम्। ततस्तामवसद्रात्रिं तापसैः परिवारिता ॥३६॥
verses.english: To a hermitage of a great souled anchorite of virtuous ways of life and she stayed there for the night surrounded by anchorites.

verses.sanskrit: आचख्यौ च यथावृत्तं सर्वमात्मनि भारत। विस्तरेण महाबाहो निखिलेन शुचिस्मिता। हरणं च विसर्गं च शाल्वेन च विसर्जनम् ॥३७॥
verses.english: That lady of sweet smiles told them, everything about herself in due order, O Bharata, in detail, the story of her abduction, her liberation and her abandonment by Shalva.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तत्र महानासीद्ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः। शेखावत्यस्तपोवृद्धः शास्त्रे चारण्यके गुरुः ॥३८॥
verses.english: There lived a great Brahmana of rigid vows Shaikhavatya by name, old in devotion and a preceptor of the holy books and the Arariyakas.

verses.sanskrit: आर्तां तामाह स मुनिः शैखावत्यो महातपाः। निःश्वसन्तीं सतीं बालां दुःखशोकपरायणाम् ॥३९॥
verses.english: That anchorite, of eminent devotion, said to that chaste lady who was in extreme difficuity and who was sighing in grief and distress.
verses.bhavadeepa: शैखावत्यः शिखावान् वह्निस्तत्साध्यानि श्रौतस्मार्तकर्माणि शैखावतानि तेषु साधुः शैखावत्यः । कर्मणि निष्णातः । आरण्यके उपनिषदि गुरुः ब्रह्मविदित्यर्थः ॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: एवं गते तु किं भद्रे शक्यं कर्तुं तपस्विभिः। आश्रमस्थैर्महाभागे तपोयुक्तैर्महात्मभिः ॥४०॥
verses.english: Such being the case, gentle lady, what can be done by devotees residing in this hermitage, of great parts and great souled though they be?

verses.sanskrit: सा त्वेनमब्रवीद्राजन् क्रियतां मदनुग्रहः। प्राव्राज्यमहमिच्छामि तपस्तप्स्यामि दुश्चरम् ॥४१॥
verses.english: She however thus replied, O king: "Show me this favour. I desire to wander about and to practice hard devotion.

verses.sanskrit: मयैव यानि कर्माणि पूर्वदेहे तु मूढया। कृतानि नूनं पापानि तेषामेतत् फलं ध्रुवम् ॥४२॥
verses.english: The deeds that had been done by me in a previous life out of folly are certainly misdeeds and this is surely the result of that.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्राव्राज्यं प्रव्रज्या संन्यासः तत्रोचितं कर्म प्राव्राज्यम् ॥४१॥

verses.sanskrit: नोत्सहे तु पुनर्गन्तुं स्वजनं प्रति तापसाः। प्रत्याख्याता निरानन्दा शाल्वेन च निराकृता ॥४३॥
verses.english: I do not venture to go back to my kindred, O devctees, rejected and rendered cheerless and y. nged by Shalva.

verses.sanskrit: उपदिष्ट‌मिहेच्छामि तापस्यं वीतकल्मषाः। युष्माभिर्देवसंकाशैः कृपा भवतु वो मयि ॥४४॥
verses.english: I wish to be instructed here (in asceticism), O ascetics, whose sins have been washed off by you who are god-like; let kindness be shown to me."

verses.sanskrit: स तामाश्वासयत् कन्यां दृष्टान्तागमहेतुभिः। सान्त्वयामास कार्यं च प्रतिजज्ञे द्विजैः सह ॥४५॥
verses.english: He then comforted that lady by citing instances and examples and consoled her by promising to do her work along with others among the twice-born.
